messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "dose may be increased to 20 mg once a day after at least 3 weeks of treatment if necessary"
set: ["dose may be increased to 20 mg once a day after at least 3 weeks of treatment if necessary", "dose may be increased to 14 mg once daily", "maintenance dose 10 to 20 mg orally once a day", "may be increased by 20 or 40 mg", "may be increased to 20 mg per day after one week if symptoms are not adequately controlled", "treatment should start at 0.4 mg once a day", "dose may go up to 50 mg once a day if tolerated", "dose may be gradually increased", "day of weekly administration can be changed if necessary", "taper dose to 150 mg once a day", "can be increased to 10 mg three times a day if needed", "increase dose to 7 mg once daily after 30 days on 3 mg dose", "increase in 2.5 mg increments after at least 4 weeks on current dose", "increase to 5 mg subcutaneously once a week after 4 weeks", "doctor may increase dose after several weeks if needed", "dose should be doubled every two weeks to the highest dose you tolerate, up to 200 mg once a day"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
